Silver order block, Thursday 12 Nov. 2R to target.

An order block is the last opposite candle before price breaks structure. Silver broke structure, then pulled back into it.

The rule: wait for structure to break, mark the last opposite candle before the break, and enter only when price comes back to it. Stop beyond the block.
